usedFor: WPForms collects form entries, and Brevo stores each sender as a contact through “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Entry” in WPForms, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A repeat sender updates the same contact instead of creating a second one.

watchOut: “Update Contact” only updates an existing contact, so use “Add Or Update Contact” for first-time senders.
